bias.zh: 看空 · 反弹逼近 100 日和 200 日均线

read.en: Meta rose 1.4% on Nov 4 to $630.00, trading between $624.50 and $643.09 on heavy volume. It is above the falling 5-day ($619.5) and 10-day ($625.2), just below the rising 200-day ($632.2) and 100-day ($633.2), and below the falling 30-day ($694.8). MACD has been below its signal since Oct 2 and below zero, histogram narrowing; Parabolic SAR has been bearish since Oct 16 ($647.82), and RSI is 40.
read.zh: Meta 11月4日上涨 1.4%，收于 $630.00，盘中区间 $624.50–643.09，成交量放大。股价位于下行的 5 日（$619.5）和 10 日均线（$625.2）上方，略低于上行的 200 日（$632.2）和 100 日均线（$633.2），并低于下行的 30 日均线（$694.8）。MACD 自 10月2日起位于信号线下方且在零轴之下，柱状图收窄；抛物线 SAR 自 10月16日起看空（$647.82），RSI 为 40。

read.en: The close cleared the $624.8–626.4 resistance (Nov 3 and Oct 30 highs), now support; the $643.09 high pushed through the 100 and 200-day and the Oct 29 high but faded. Resistance is $632.2–634.7, then $643.1–648.0 (Nov 4 high, SAR, Oct 23 and 26 highs). Support is $624.5–626.4, then $619.2–619.5 and $606.4–610.1. A close above $634.7 would target $643–648; below $624.5, $619.

r.en: Nov 4 high $643.1; Parabolic SAR $647.8; Oct 23 and Oct 26 highs ($647.7–648.0)

s.en: 10-day average $625.2; Nov 3 and Oct 30 highs ($624.8–626.4), reclaimed; Nov 4 low $624.5
Oct 30 and Nov 3 lows ($610.1); Nov 2 low $606.4
